meta.title: A section-wise scoring template only fits Vendor Assessment

plan.title: Section-wise scoring template rejected outside Vendor Assessment

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the required project title for the create flow.
Configure the requested Technical and RFQ stages.
Configure the Technical stage where the section selection is tested.
Apply the available technical-stage template before accessing its sections.
Move to the pricing stage to add the project line item required for per-line-item technical sections.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding items.
Create a line item so a per-line-item RFI/RFP section exists.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet required by the create flow.
Return to the Technical stage and its per-line-item questionnaire sections.

args.goal: On the Technical stage, open a per-line-item RFI/RFP section outside Vendor Assessment, attempt to select a section-wise scoring template, and stop with the refusal message visible: "Section-wise scoring templates can only be selected in the Vendor Assessment section."

steps.note: Perform the section-specific template selection that no dedicated catalog step can express.

args.text: Section-wise scoring templates can only be selected in the Vendor Assessment section.

steps.note: Assert the exact refusal message from the attempted selection.
